name: @emsenn/infomaterial-lean-project
description: Infomaterial's local Lean-library instantiation of the generic ICK computing and organizing proof-operation surfaces.

scripts.lean:audit: pnpm run lean:audit:packaging && pnpm run lean:audit:blueprint
scripts.lean:audit:blueprint: node scripts/blueprint-coverage.mjs && node scripts/audit-blueprint-incidence.mjs --fail && node scripts/lean-blueprint-weld.mjs --fail
scripts.lean:mcp: uvx lean-lsp-mcp --lean-project-path . --instructions "Infomaterial Lean proofing server. Use Lean LSP tools before shell/read/grep for Lean questions: diagnostics, goal, hover, outline, local_search, verify, and multi_attempt. Whole-project checks still use make build or make check."
